Brain metastases (BMs) are a major cause of mortality in patients with melanoma. We conducted a retrospective observational study to identify prognostic factors for BM development and to evaluate the impact of first‐line systemic therapy on BM occurrence and survival outcomes in patients with advanced melanoma. A total of 258 patients with unresectable Stage III or IV melanoma without BM at diagnosis were included and followed for BM occurrence.
